title: 5.4.13 Lab — Loop over an array of instances
description: Write a `for...of` loop in `draw()` that calls `.render()` on each enemy — dispatching a method to every element in the array with one loop.

steps.title: Loop over enemies and call .render() on each
steps.instructions: In `draw()`, write a `for...of` loop over the `enemies` array. Inside the loop, call `.render()` on the loop variable. All five HP labels should appear on screen.
hints: Open the moSHion docs drawer on the right and review the array and loop sections — a for...of loop gives you each element one at a time.

requirements.title: for loop over enemies in draw()
requirements.description: Write a `for...of` (or `for` index) loop over the `enemies` array inside `draw()`.

requirements.title: Method called on loop variable
requirements.description: Inside the loop body, call a method on the loop variable (e.g. `e.render()`).
